title: Reliable sending and login checks
notes: Long and multi-line prompts, including prompts loaded with --file, are confirmed as sent; Enter is used as a fallback when needed.
A failed send reports [SUBMIT FAILED] with the failed check, tab URL, and browser profile instead of incorrectly saying ChatGPT is not logged in.
Prompt text that mentions login no longer makes a logged-in page look logged out.
Setup reports the ChatGPT login state and starts a stopped browser bridge.
